# sessions.guide

sessions.guide is a booking platform for practitioners of the healing arts,
where seekers find and book reiki, astrology, sound healing, ceremony, and
other transformational sessions directly with the practitioner.

Operated by Sessions Guide Inc., incorporated in Canada.
Launch markets: United States, Australia, Indonesia.
Practitioners join by invitation. Seekers can browse and book without one.
Practitioners pay a flat monthly subscription from $0. The platform takes
nothing from session payments.

## Authoritative pages
- /mission: why the platform exists, from the founder
- /help/seekers: booking, payment, cancellation, refunds
- /help/practitioners: listing, session types, availability, payouts, reviews
- /pricing: current subscription tiers and prices
- /explore: all twelve categories
